verdict: PASS (small): +0.065 dB mean; the floor holes are filled (view 28 +1.99 dB). Two low floor views get worse (19 -0.86, 10 -0.61) because the proxy texture is lighter and softer than the splat carpet near the wall line.

testflight.reason: The box cannot reach the Supabase project host: TLS handshake ends with unexpected EOF (curl 35). *.supabase.co resolves to the egress gateway 198.18.0.1; supabase.com and GitHub are reachable. Package v3 is not uploaded and dispatch-v7 cannot sign URLs, so there is no internal-debug build yet. Not routed around.
